title: Non-Kähler metrics on complex manifolds of LVMB type
summary: LVMB manifolds are a class of non-Kähler compact complex manifolds with a remarkably rich geometry: in many cases they admit a holomorphic bundle structure over a compact toric manifold. In fact, such a bundle is determined by an algebro-combinatoric datum encapsulating a simplicial fan. This is reflected in a close relationship between the geometry of an LVMB manifold and that of its toric base space. Throughout this paper, we restrict to this subclass of LVMB manifolds.
